headline: MIT Breakthrough: LLMs Enable Robots to Grasp Vague Human Instructions and Crucial Details
reason: Published on June 26, 2026, MIT researchers have developed a novel approach using two large language models (LLMs) to enhance human-robot interaction. This marks a significant breakthrough in LLM application for robotics and dexterity.
